name: Vasily I of Moscow
role: Grand Prince of Moscow from 1389 to 1425
contribution: He was the heir of Dmitry Donskoy, who reigned from 1359 to 1389.
legacy: The raid on the Volga region in 1395 by the Turco-Mongol emir Timur resulted in a state of anarchy for the Golden Horde and the independence of Moscow.

checks.lead: Vasily I Dmitriyevich (Russian: Василий I Дмитриевич; 30 December 1371 – 27 February 1425) was Grand Prince of Vladimir and Moscow from 1389. He was the heir of Dmitry Donskoy, who reigned from 1359 to 1389.
